summary_1line: Sugriva gathers the monkey hosts and ceremonially meets Rama, promising vast armies to aid the search for Sita and the coming war with Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva and Lakshmana ride a golden litter beneath a white canopy while monkeys carry weapons and conches sound around them.
Sugriva prostrates before Rama, touching his head to Rama’s feet as a vast monkey army gathers behind him like a lake of lotus buds.
Rama lifts Sugriva up and embraces him warmly while ranks of monkeys stand with joined palms in the forest clearing.
